verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a seller-side catalog feed where each CSV row is a product or variant, with pricing and inventory refreshed about every 15 minutes, so price, availability and variants can be shared with agents. The agent-side embedded mode ingests these product feeds so AI interfaces can discover products. However, that access is in private preview and limited to sellers with a confirmed OCA, so it is not open read access to "any" listed product. missing for 10: a documented developer-facing read API or schema for offer data, explicit checkout-link fields, open access beyond OCA-connected sellers in private preview, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: It lets you share product, price, and availability information with agents while minimizing changes to your existing commerce systems.
Format your feed as a CSV where each row is a product or variant
the full checkout lifecycle through Stripe, including product feed ingestion, cart management, fulfillment, and payment collection
ACS works across multiple commerce protocols, so your AI interface can discover products, collect payment information, and complete purchases on behalf of sellers.
